basic_details.job_title: AECS Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for TGT, PRT Posts
basic_details.short_information: Atomic Energy Central Schools & Junior College, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai will hold a skill test and practical classroom observation (or demo teaching class) on 03rd Dec 2026 at AECS-2, with reporting between 9:00 am and 10 am. It is for engaging contract teachers in the AEC Schools/Junior College for Academic Year 2026-27: TGT (English, Social Science, Marathi), PRT and PRT (Music). Consolidated pay is Rs. 34,125/- per month for TGT and Rs. 27,625/- per month for PRT/PRT Music.

age_limit.details: The age limit for all posts is 18 - 65 years as on 01-04-2026. The notice prints no age relaxation.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Degree as described below, with English as an elective/major subject in graduation in at least three years / six semesters of course

Degree as described below, with any two subjects out of History, Geography, Economics and Political Science, one of which must be History or Geography in at least three years / six semesters as Elective/Main Subject and the second for at least one year / any two semesters
Degree as described below, with Marathi as an elective/major subject in graduation in all the three years / six semesters of the course

Pass in Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 2 years Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed.) / 4 years Bachelor's Degree in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) / 2 years Diploma in Education (Sp Ed) from RCI
Senior Secondary / Higher Secondary / Intermediate (Class XII) with 50% marks from a recognized board AND Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized Institution/University

qualification.details: Three years Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University with at least 50% marks in aggregate (or equivalent CGPA converted to percentage as per the University's/institution's norms) in the respective subject(s) / combination of subjects; OR a four years integrated degree course, B.A.Ed. or B.Sc.Ed., from a Regional College of Education of NCERT / any NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate. B.Ed. or equivalent degree from any recognized University/Institute. B.Ed. is not required for candidates with B.Sc.Ed, B.A.Ed. or M.Sc.Ed. Qualified in Paper-II of the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by the CBSE as per NCTE guidelines. Proficiency in teaching in English medium, except for TGT (Marathi). Proficiency in teaching in English medium. | Class XII with 50% marks from a recognized board AND Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized Institution/University, provided music was studied in all the years of the degree as main subject. content_sections.heading: About Atomic Energy Central Schools & Junior College
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of Chairman, Local Managing Committee, Atomic Energy Central Schools & Junior College, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai. It invites teachers on contract basis for the AEC Schools/Junior College, Anushaktinagar, Mumbai. The engagement is against leave / regular vacancies that may arise during Academic Year 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Three years Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University with at least 50% marks in aggregate (or equivalent CGPA converted to percentage as per the University's/institution's norms) in the respective subject(s) / combination of subjects; OR a four years integrated degree course, B.A.Ed. or B.Sc.Ed., from a Regional College of Education of NCERT / any NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate. B.Ed. or equivalent degree from any recognized University/Institute. B.Ed. is not required for candidates with B.Sc.Ed, B.A.Ed. or M.Sc.Ed. Qualified in Paper-II of the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) conducted by the CBSE as per NCTE guidelines. Proficiency in teaching in English medium, except for TGT (Marathi). Note: candidates without B.Ed. and CTET can also apply if they have 60% and above marks (Science subjects) or 55% and above marks (Humanities subjects) at graduation level. Class XII (Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate) with at least 50% marks and D.El.Ed. (2 years) / B.El.Ed. (4 years) / 2 years Diploma in Education (Sp Ed) from RCI. Qualified in CTET Paper-I conducted by the CBSE as per NCTE guidelines. Proficiency in teaching in English medium. Class XII with 50% marks from a recognized board AND Bachelor's Degree in Music/Performing Arts from a recognized Institution/University, provided music was studied in all the years of the degree as main subject. A candidate having a diploma in Music is not eligible for the post. The age limit for all posts is 18 - 65 years as on 01-04-2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates without teaching qualification (B.Ed., D.El.Ed, B.EL.Ed, CTET) can also apply and will be empanelled separately on selection. For the subject-wise eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The prescribed application form, giving age, qualification, experience, address for correspondence, contact numbers and e-mail id. A passport size photograph with signature across the photo, affixed on each application. One set of self-attested photocopies of mark sheets and all relevant certificates of the qualifying degree. Original documents, for verification. A separate application form for each post, if applying for more than one post. The application form is on pages 4 and 5 of the notice. It asks for name, date of birth, address, mobile no., email id, gender, qualification details (X, XII, Diploma, Degree, Post-graduation, Teaching Qualification), CTET score (Part-1/Part-2), years of teaching experience, English as a subject in Class XII (Yes/No) and basic knowledge of computer (Yes/No), followed by a declaration signed by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report between 9:00 am and 10 am on 03rd Dec 2026 and submit the application form at the respective schools. The notice gives the reporting time as 9.00 AM. A skill test and practical classroom observation (or a Demo Teaching Class) is conducted. Performance is assessed on a presentation on two topics, one chosen by the candidate and the other provided by the school, followed by personal interaction on the subject. Topics are based on NCERT textbooks: Primary syllabus for PRT and PRT (Music); syllabus of classes 6-10 for TGT (Social Science), TGT (English) and TGT (Marathi). Candidates are called for the demo on a first-come, first-served basis, irrespective of the panel to which they belong. Selected candidates are empanelled and recruited in the order of merit. Panel I: candidates with all the requisite qualifications. Panel II: candidates without CTET score. Panel III: candidates without teaching qualification. The panels are operated in sequential order, in the order of their merit.

faq.question: Q1. When is the AEJC walk-in skill test for teachers?
faq.answer: The skill test and practical classroom observation (or demo class) for all posts is on 03rd Dec 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Reporting is between 9:00 am and 10 am, and the venue is AECS-2. No candidate is entertained beyond reporting hours.

faq.question: Q3. Which posts are open?
faq.answer: The posts are TGT (English), TGT (Social Science), TGT (Marathi), PRT and PRT (Music), on contract basis for Academic Year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary?
faq.answer: TGT gets Rs. 34,125/- per month (Consolidated). PRT and PRT Music get Rs. 27,625/- per month (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 - 65 years as on 01-04-2026 for all posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for PRT?
faq.answer: Class XII with at least 50% marks and D.El.Ed. / B.El.Ed. / 2 years Diploma in Education (Sp Ed) from RCI, plus CTET Paper-I and proficiency in teaching in English medium.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates without B.Ed. or CTET apply?
faq.answer: Yes. For TGT, candidates without B.Ed. and CTET can apply with 60% and above marks (Science subjects) or 55% and above (Humanities subjects) at graduation level. Candidates without teaching qualification are empanelled separately.

faq.question: Q8. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: Selection is by a skill test and practical classroom observation, with a presentation on two topics and a personal interaction. Candidates are empanelled in the order of merit in three panels.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry the application form with a passport size photograph, one set of self-attested photocopies of mark sheets and certificates, and the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are contract engagements, and the panel is valid till 31st March 2027. The contract can be terminated if performance is not as required.
